description: Implementation of the Messenger plugin class in the WPEFramework project, handling room management, message sending, and related operations.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: A class managing chat rooms and messaging functionality within the plugin.

methods.name: const string Initialize(PluginHost::IShell * service)
methods.description: Initializes the Messenger plugin, setting up necessary services and room admin.

methods.name: void Deinitialize(PluginHost::IShell * service)
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters the Messenger plugin.

methods.name: string JoinRoom(const string & roomName,const string & userName)
methods.description: Allows a user to join a chat room, creating a room ID and managing the notification sink.

methods.name: bool SubscribeUserUpdate(const string & roomId,bool subscribe)
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes a user update callback for a specific room.

methods.name: bool LeaveRoom(const string & roomId)
methods.description: Removes a user from a specified chat room.

methods.name: bool SendMessage(const string & roomId,const string & message)
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified chat room.

methods.name: string GenerateRoomId(const string & roomName,const string & userName)
methods.description: Generates a unique room ID based on room name, user name, and current time.

ctags.name: GenerateRoomId
ctags.pattern: /^    string Messenger::GenerateRoomId(const string& roomName, const string& userName)$/

ctags.pattern: /^    string Messenger::JoinRoom(const string& roomName, const string& userName)$/

ctags.pattern: /^    bool Messenger::SendMessage(const string& roomId, const string& message)$/
